bullets: browser/scrolling: Page Up and Page Down
browser/scrolling: A page is the number of rows that fit the viewport minus one, kept as overlap
browser/selection: Shift+Page Up and Shift+Page Down extend or shrink the selection by one page from the range anchor.
browser/selection: In List, Icons, and Columns, plain Home, End, Page Up, and Page Down move the range anchor to the new cursor.
